purpose: Keep official or source-backed study notes as default LLM Wiki evidence, while keeping project and personal notes as contextual layers.

conditional_context_statuses.active: Use for project logs, current questions, RAG evaluation, debugging, and next-task planning. Do not treat as default official evidence.
conditional_context_statuses.migration-report: Use only for vault structure audits.
conditional_context_statuses.source-outline: Use only for source inventory checks.

wiki_standardized_rule: Exclude from the default answer index. Use only as explicit fallback when no expanded or project note exists, and label the result as draft-level.
